title: One additional finite gate for the unchanged public-grid tree family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total public rational-grid tree-disperser language family.evaluate on all actual N input bits, defined completely in family.py and proof.md. Its unchanged exact public controller selects the least accepted certificate dimension d_N, or sets d_N=N+1 and outputs0 on fallback. No field-polynomial prefix or advice is added. Component fields, primitive maps, six-coordinate rational grid, clipping guards and all ties are fixed by the supplied implementation.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this single total uniform polynomial-time language in the pinned full B2 model, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8d_N+5 for EVERY integer N>=0, with exact selected certificate dimension d_N from family.py and fallback d_N=N+1. At every sufficiently large integer length d_N<=2^ceil(881813Z/200000), where Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). For EVERY fixed real epsilon>0 there exists N_epsilon such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon for EVERY integer N>=N_epsilon. Hence liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4 for this same eligible family. The new finite offset is one gate stronger than the supplied previous +4 certificate for this identical evaluator; no higher leading coefficient or record claim is made.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
